newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia rate cut benefits this year - Howard.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia rate cut benefits this year - Howard.

text.p: Australian Prime Minister John Howard said on Monday the benefits of last year's three official interest rate cuts would flow through this year.

"The benefits of those (rate cuts) commonly lag by something like 12 to 18 months, so we can see through the whole of this year the beneficial effects beginning to flow through," Howard told parliament.
